text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae delivered real results in 
the race! Hearing the crowd's roaring 
response, Hokko Tarumae felt a sense of 
triumph and confidence unlike anything 
she'd experienced before!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On social media, however, a post wishing 
Hokko Tarumae would focus on racing rather 
than being a local idol sparked a fierce 
debate between supporters and opponents.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Through debates lasting past midnight, 
Hokko Tarumae learned that people only saw 
her either as a dirt Umamusume or as an 
idol—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even though she had poured her heart into 
promoting Tomakomai, her feelings hadn't 
gotten across. She agonized over the fact 
that people hadn't taken her seriously.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To encourage Hokko Tarumae, the Trainer 
devises a plan together with Smart 
Falcon—so that she can run in the Kashiwa 
Kinen once more.
